chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan ibn Sayf ibn 'Umaira, from 'Abdullah ibn Abi Ya'fur, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
One who recites Surah al-Ahqaf every night or every Friday, Allah will protect him from anxiety in the worldly life and secure him from the terror of the Day of Resurrection, if Allah wills.

key_terms.سُورَةَ الْأَحْقَافِ: Surah Al-Ahqaf (The Sand Dunes), the 46th chapter of the Quran

ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual benefits of reciting Surah Al-Ahqaf?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Thawab al-A'mal*, this hadith emphasizes the protective power of reciting Surah al-Ahqaf, either nightly or weekly, linking it to divine tranquility in this life and security from the Great Fear on the Day of Resurrection. This practice reflects the Shia tradition of using specific Quranic chapters as spiritual remedies (du'a) to ward off anxiety and prepare the soul for the Hereafter.
